requirements.summit: Large flat public landscape; access independent of wealth and home address

geometry.status: Exploratory geometry. All floors above grade; legacy 30 basements removed from this case. Open streets and courts are explicit voids, not established canon.

compute.status: Equipment sensitivity, not proof of capacity for the AI population. Active rack counts are unresolved workload scenarios, independent of city area.
compute.note: Rack density and component areas are planning inputs. PUE covers facility overhead; spare installed capacity is not added as active IT demand. No capacity promise or redundancy topology is implied.

district.note: Case A district. Local common civic program drawn under the blocks; remaining area is a share of citywide facilities, not duplicated locally. Six-storey neighborhood bands are organizational only, not fire-code compartments.

resource_sensitivity.status: Deliberately broad arithmetic sensitivities, not material selection, structural member sizing, calibrated energy intensities or a whole-project bill of quantities. Noncompute electricity excludes the separately modeled compute campus. Constant compute load is assumed for the annual-energy illustration.

summit.note: Illustrative human visitor traffic only; embodied AI, accessibility arrangements, staff, freight, transfer times and event surges need separate modeling. Lift arithmetic is a capacity sensitivity, not an engineered installation.
